name: Junior Volunteers at St. Luke's
what_you_do: Volunteer at the Boise campus of St. Luke's. The program has orientation, service training, quarterly meetings and monthly service hours.
who_can_apply: Ages 16 to 18. Must be at least 16 before the program starts in January. Minimum 3.0 GPA. Boise campus only. The program cannot take new volunteers past their junior year of high school.
duration: 8 hours a month during the school year and 12 hours a month in June, July and August
deadline_text: Applications opened Nov 2, 2026, the first Monday in November. Closing date not stated on the program page. A limited number are available and they fill quickly.
how_to_apply: Submit the online application. Call (208) 381-2265 with questions. You must also finish orientation and service training. You must attend quarterly meetings. You also need proof of immunizations (MMR, varicella, Tdap, T-spot and a current flu shot).
notes: The opening date of Nov 2 is worked out from the page rule, which says the first Monday in November. The date is not printed on the page. The online application form loaded with its questions on 2026-11-02, but the page itself does not say in words that it is open.
